scoring.description: Card points from captured cards plus bonuses for matrimonial combinations. Card values follow Briscola conventions: aces are worth 11 points, threes 10 points, kings 4, queens or horses 3, jacks 2, and all other cards 0. Points accumulate across deals.
scoring.winCondition: The first player to reach or exceed 151 total card points, including matrimonio bonuses, wins the game.
